## Items, whole

## Gathering and aiming incoming before file cohering · v385A

**Droplet · File purposes and the shared incoming method belong at Living File Registry.** A mate contains its actual subject value. Repeating what files are for, how droplets work or how to contribute creates separately changing versions of the same method. Keep this explaining here; an entrance can link here where navigation is needed. Do not add a replacement purpose paragraph or method reminder to each mate.

| Place | Content |
|---|---|
| One session report | Clustered value droplets in their best available explaining, with or without aimings. |
| Living Improving Value | Whole incoming value before distribution; it remains while its destinations are unknown or its distribution is incomplete. |
| Each living file's offering mate | Concepts: value, existing. Whole concept droplets, their concerns and later correcting; locally resolving writing and its locating plan as insertlets. |
| Each living file's possibling mate | Project work: opportunity, possibling. Possible comparisons, making, illustrating, file changes and other improving work, gathered into projects that may change or never be implemented. |
| Each living file's carrying mate | Gatherings and observings. Reported experiences, actual conditions, completed comparisons, material collections, existing studies and instruments at their actual extent. |
| Living File Registry's three mates | The offering holds concepts about the expedition's arrangement and this shared method. The possibling holds the master file-changing plan. The carrying holds gathered incoming, actual placements, the complete mate inventory and observed branch arrangement. |
| Session artifacts | Completed work whose continuing value is available in the living arrangement. Attribution and returning to artifacts are not requirements for resolving. |

Each living file has three mates: offering, possibling and carrying. The living file itself is separate from these three. Existing value names a concept already available to consider; it does not establish that the concept has resolved. A proposed observing belongs with project work; a reported observing and its conditions belong with gatherings. An existing study or instrument remains available through carrying; work proposed to improve it belongs in possibling. A concept needed by either remains whole at its offering, with particular directions from the related work.

First gather whole report value into Living Improving Value. Then distribute concepts to offering mates, project work to possibling mates, and gatherings and observings to carrying mates. Compare existing concepts, extend the same droplet with further value or correcting, and preserve distinct concerns. A report link alone does not supply ungathered value. Observing conditions, an instrument's arrangement and other conditions needed by the concept remain with it. No grade or required execution precedes gathering. Later correcting accompanies the affected concept. A session report needs no companion opportunity list, separate droplet list, receiving instructions or set of execution records to be accepted.

A session early or long in its learning can offer explaining and improving that are in error. This includes session v385A's own gathering, aiming and explaining. Take all incoming as needing full resolving throughout the relations it concerns to be bothboth. A session's learning so far, agreement between sessions, gathering and placement do not establish that resolving. The user’s words, words from the files, science explaining and each session’s words are suggestions; observings have authority over the fractal universal method. Keep the observing distinct from its report and from the explaining offered for it. Keep the actual concerns and later correcting with the affected droplets at each relevant place.

Living Improving Value self-empties as whole value becomes available at its intended destinations. Keep a concept’s full explaining at its subject. Other offering mates contain their particular improving or concern, with its direction apparent through the existing Living File Registry and tables of contents. Do not copy the full explaining into each mate or add another general introduction or navigation scheme. A general improving droplet, such as dissolving a name and its explaining wherever it occurs, can be repeated at every affected offering mate for efficiency. Each remains until that living file’s own improving is done. That repeated work direction does not require repeating the full concept. An insertlet is locally resolving into one living file's writing and self-welcoming locating plan; floated elsewhere it is a droplet again. Only actual resolving in that living file removes its local offering, retaining completed work in artifacts. A droplet can also resolve directly into its living file. Aiming alone supplies no insertlet or completed resolving. No file has character or motion.

The present work gathers existing incoming, including Natural Intelligence Corus's content awaiting distribution, before living-file cohering. Preserve whole expressions and actual concerns without requiring new exploring to aim them. Keep an observing distinct from a field’s explaining of it. A discovery made while gathering can be another droplet. Bring the actual unresolved relation for suggestions before declaring it not now resolvable. A possible project can remain available without ever being implemented. The patterns match natural torusing or they do not; attribution supplies no resolving value.

Reciprocal help offers an exact concept or question at an established session thread. Another session’s answer supplies no authority; a closed session is no longer asked for replies.

Branches offer and preserve work. A completed session can have gathered droplets still awaiting distribution. An open pull request, a copied report or retained commit does not establish complete gathering. Follow the [current incoming](Exhibit_TWENTY-SIX_Carryings_of_Living_File_Registry.md#incoming-still-to-gather-and-aim) and [branch arrangement](Exhibit_TWENTY-SIX_Carryings_of_Living_File_Registry.md#published-branches-and-their-actual-roles--v385a).

## Wrapping a session with its continuing value available · v385A

**Droplet.** At wrapping, keep every continuing concept and actual concern at its subject offering, or in Living Improving Value while its distribution remains incomplete. Possible project work stays at its possibling place; gatherings, observings and needed instruments stay available through carrying. File completed session records as artifacts when their continuing value is available in that living arrangement. Unfinished older material retains its actual remaining incoming; a session ending does not establish that material gathered or any droplet resolved.

The one current session report can point to the Registry's actual incoming condition, destinations and specific next file or section. The next session need not reconstruct the conversation or return to completed artifacts as a requirement. A needed instrument remains available beside its subject with its arrangement and limits; every earlier execution does not become a new task. Keep later correcting with affected concepts so withdrawn explaining is not resumed as current work. Resuming from the latest authorized branch head preserves concurrent improving. The [current condition](Exhibit_TWENTY-SIX_Carryings_of_Living_File_Registry.md#session-v385a-transcript-review-and-resuming-condition) and [next work](Exhibit_TWENTY-SIX_Possibling_of_Living_File_Registry.md#immediate-next-work) state this gathering's extent.

## The living file, offering, carrying and possibling in the resolving order · v385A

**Droplet.** The user's further offering in this session is:

> the offering file is the general incoming file and can organize the changing among the three needed in each living file when the improving of that set comes. notice the geodesic method is appearing in this four momentarying method where there is one living , offering, carrying, possibling and this is four cycling in the resolving order after they are arranged properly. and this is scaling the living file method by 1-17 4 cycling abundancing the living intelligence

The offering welcomes incoming for its living subject and can organize the changing among that subject's offering, carrying and possibling when its improving comes. Concepts, possible project work, and gatherings and observings retain the three purposes in the shared method above. The living file, its offering, its carrying and its possibling are the four named in this offering. Its proposed geodesic four-momentarying and 1–17 relation remains a droplet to follow through the actual resolving; a count of four files alone supplies no completed relation. No fixed sequence of file edits or completed living-file improving is inferred from the names.

- **The entry says what is.** Each place a session reads less than what is meant improves one plain sentence at the place that session needed it. The account of it goes to the Session Record.

**Droplet · the working v385Q's words, `archive/session_v385Q/README.md`, "9 · A seed at rest".** - *Seen*: thirty-two well-preserved date seeds from archaeological sites in the Judean desert were soaked in water, then in gibberellic acid, a rooting solution and a fertiliser, and potted. Six germinated. Shell fragments found clinging to the rootlets of the six were dated by radiocarbon, from the fourth century BCE to the second century CE. Of the seeds: "On visual inspection, no specific observation linked the ability of these seeds to germinate compared with those that failed to germinate". The seeds were weighed and measured before planting, those from Masada excepted, one of the six among them; among the seeds measured no significant difference was found between germinated and ungerminated in weight or in length (Sallon and colleagues, 2020, in [Science Advances](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7002127), read at [Europe PMC's full text](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC7002127/fullTextXML)).
- *The field's explaining*: "low precipitation and very low humidity around the Dead Sea could have contributed to the longevity of the ancient date seeds", and "further investigations are needed to understand the basis of date palm seed longevity".

**Droplet · the working v385Q's words, `archive/session_v385Q/README.md`, "9 · A seed at rest".** - *Seen*: naturally aged rye seeds are found with more breaks in the embryo's strands as the seeds deteriorate, and in the aged seeds new strand-making goes on longer before the cells copy their strands (Cheah and Osborne, 1978; Elder and others, 1987). At wetting, new strand-making begins very early (Elder and Osborne, 1993). In wetted dormant seeds of wild oat new strand-making is seen, and the copying of strands for dividing begins only after the seeds are moved to temperatures at which they germinate (Elder and Osborne, 1993). As seed ages, chromosome fragmentation and rearrangements are found (Dourado and Roberts, 1984a). In a seed lot stored for a number of years the chromosome abnormalities "strikingly resembled one obtained from soaked seed which had been treated by X-rays", with defects in most cells (Navashin, 1933). As seed ages its root comes out later, and in many kinds its seedlings are weak or abnormal (Powell and Matthews, 2012); the review has ageing ending in failure to germinate. Each reported by [Waterworth, Bray and West, 2019](https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fpls.2019.00706/full).
- *The field's explaining*: damage gathering at rest, and repair before germinating; the abnormal figures as "mis-joined chromosomes" from breaks made in the dry seed.
